Lake · Flagship Pontoons

Flagship Pontoon Boats — Discover, Endurance & Freedom

Built right here in Wisconsin (Withee, WI) on a 3" structural cross-beam — stronger than the 2" beam most of the industry runs on — and powered by Suzuki Marine outboards. Three series, one strong platform: pick the level of luxury, durability, and style that fits how you use the water.

← Back to Lake equipment
Lake LoungerFlagship

Jump to a series: Discover · Endurance · Freedom · Which one is right for you?

Discover

$34,972 – $48,853

The flagship of the Flagship line. Reclining helm chair, FUSION sound, and the biggest tubes in the lineup — built for owners who want the full luxury pontoon experience.

Endurance

$29,904 – $35,973

The do-everything family pontoon. Same 3" structural beam and premium furniture as Discover, sized and priced for everyday lake life.

Freedom

$25,053 – $33,208

The accessible entry point into Flagship's structural platform — with available carbon-fiber graphics for a sharper look, without cutting corners.

MSRP ranges reflect Flagship Pontoons' published pricing and vary by length and package. Ask your dealer for current availability.

Discover Series — the flagship of the fleet

Discover is the top of the Flagship lineup: the boat for owners who want every ride on the water to feel like a getaway. It's the most decked-out series they build, from the reclining helm chair to the largest tubes available, and it's designed to be as comfortable at the dock as it is cruising wide open water.

Reclining helm chair
25" diameter logs
FUSION sound system
10' power bimini
Handicap accessible gates

Sizes & layouts

  • 20, 22, 25, and 27 ft models
  • Cruise (CU) — open, versatile seating
  • Rear Fish (RF) — open rear fence for fishing
  • L-Seat (LS) — 20' and 22' models
  • Bed layout (B) — 22, 25, 27 ft

Standard features

  • Premium soft-touch furniture
  • Luxury woven vinyl flooring
  • Deluxe console with vinyl top
  • Full-length tube M-bracket & deck rub rail
  • Gauge package: speedo & multifunction display
  • Black powder-coated 2.5" rails, 8.5' wide deck

Best for: owners who want the most premium, feature-rich pontoon on the lake and don't want to choose between comfort, sound, and standout looks.

Endurance Series — built for everyday lake life

Endurance carries the same 3" structural beam and premium furniture as Discover, packaged into sizes built for the way most families actually use a pontoon: weekends at the sandbar, evening cruises, and fishing trips that turn into swim stops. It's the sweet spot between price and capability.

25" tubes on every model
Premium furniture
KICKER stereo
10' bimini top
Seat slider

Sizes & layouts

  • 16, 18, 20, and 22 ft models
  • Cruise (CU) — 20' and 22'
  • Rear Fish (RF) — 20' and 22'
  • Four-Corner Fish (FC) — 18' and 20'
  • L-Seat (LS) — 18' and 20'

Standard features

  • Luxury woven vinyl flooring
  • Black powder-coated 2.5" rails
  • 8.5' wide deck on every model
  • New roto console
  • Gauge package: fuel & tach
  • No-feedback tilt steering

Best for: families who want a durable, well-equipped pontoon at a more accessible price than Discover, without giving up the structural strength Flagship is known for.

Freedom Series — the smart way onto the water

Freedom is Flagship's entry point — proof that a lower price doesn't mean a lower standard. It rides on the same structural platform as the rest of the lineup, and with six premium colors plus available carbon-fiber graphics, it's often the sharpest-looking boat at the landing.

Carbon-fiber graphics available
25" tubes on every model
Premium furniture
8.5' wide deck
KICKER stereo

Sizes & layouts

  • 16, 18, 20, and 22 ft models
  • Cruise (CU) — 20' and 22'
  • L-Seat (LS) — 16', 18', and 20'
  • Front Fish (FF) — 16'

Standard features

  • Luxury woven vinyl flooring
  • Black powder-coated 2.5" rails
  • 10' bimini top
  • New roto console
  • Gauge package: fuel & tach
  • Seat slider

Best for: first-time pontoon owners or budget-conscious buyers who still want Flagship's structural durability and a sharp-looking boat.

Which one is right for you?

All three series share the same 3" structural beam and Suzuki Marine power, so you're never sacrificing durability — the choice really comes down to budget and how much luxury you want on board.

  • Want the best boat on the lake? Go Discover — the reclining helm chair and FUSION sound make every trip feel like a vacation.
  • Want a durable family boat that does it all? Go Endurance — the best balance of features and price.
  • New to pontoons or watching the budget? Go Freedom — the same structural platform, styled sharp, at the most accessible price.

Lake · Lake Lounger

Lake Lounger Pontoon Boats — Console & Electric Models

Built in Stanley, WI, Lake Lounger pontoons are designed for low-maintenance, stress-free days on the water. Choose the quiet, eco-friendly Electric model for small lakes and no-wake zones, or step up to the Console model with a Suzuki Marine outboard for cruising and fishing bigger water. Available in 13, 16, 20, and 22 ft lengths.

← Back to Lake equipment
Lake LoungerFlagship

Available lengths

Model typeLengthsBest for
Console13, 16, 20, 22 ftCruising & fishing, with outboard power
Electric13, 16, 20, 22 ftQuiet, low-maintenance days on the water

Console model power options

The Console model is available with an outboard from 25 HP up to 60 HP, so you can size the power to how you use the boat — easy cruising, watersports, or fishing farther from the dock. Less weight and less wind resistance than a traditional pontoon means the Console model stays stable, handles well, and can float in shallow water. Ask your dealer which HP option is the best fit for your lake.

Features

  • Live well (fishing models)
  • Dedicated fishing seats
  • Hinged anchor bracket
  • Stainless steel cables
  • Party rail
  • Running lights
  • 25" pontoon logs
  • Suzuki Marine outboard power

Popular upgrades

  • Black power bimini top
  • Trolling motor
  • Batteries & charger
  • Detachable ladder
  • Solar post cap
  • Safety gate

Pontoon layout configurations

Nine seating and storage layouts are available on both the Electric and Console models. Battery, livewell, and storage placement can be mixed and matched to fit how you use the boat.

Luxury vinyl flooring

Every Lake Lounger comes with durable, low-maintenance woven vinyl flooring in your choice of two colors — easy to clean and built to handle wet feet, pets, and gear all season long.
